Qiyana|mid.identity: Physical damage assassin who wields the elements. Terrashape (W) dashes her toward a bush, the river or a wall to empower her Elemental Wrath (Q): invisibility (grass), CC then a slow (water), more damage to wounded targets (rock). Audacity (E) dashes onto an enemy, and Supreme Display of Talent (R) knocks back; enemies knocked into a wall are stunned and the terrain explodes.
Qiyana|mid.playstyle: Lane-dominant, roaming assassin. She punishes immobile mages and roams with the grass element.
Qiyana|mid.early_game: Start with W to pick up an element, then poke with an empowered Q. Rock hurts wounded targets; water roots for an all-in with your jungler. Keep E to stick to a target or escape.
Qiyana|mid.level_1: Terrashape (W) first in mid. Pick up an element to empower your first Q.
Qiyana|mid.level_2: Elemental Wrath (Q). Poke with your chosen element: W → Q.
Qiyana|mid.level_3: Audacity (E). All-in: E → Q (the right element) → W → Q.
Qiyana|mid.level_6: Supreme Display of Talent: look for angles where R pushes your opponent into a wall or along the river. Roam to the side lanes with the grass element (invisible).
power_spikes: Level 3: all-in with the right element.
First completed item: burst that kills mages.
Qiyana|mid.lane_plan: Dominate the lane with your elements, take plates and roam. The mid role quest (faster recall) makes your roams more profitable. Avoid tanks and mages who lock you down (Vex).
Qiyana|mid.trading: Short trade: W → Q. All-in: E → Q (water to root) → W → Q → R into a wall. Engage when the enemy CC is on cooldown; give up on it against tanks (mid Malphite).
threats: Vex, whose passive interrupts your dashes.
Mid Malphite and tanks who soak your burst.
CC cast in the middle of your combo.
mistakes: Using the wrong element for the situation.
Casting your ultimate with no wall behind the target.
Staying in lane with a lead instead of roaming.

matchup_notes.Zed: Root him with the water element when he swaps back to his shadow.
matchup_notes.Ahri: Dodge her Charm and turn your lead into roams.
matchup_notes.Yasuo: His Wind Wall blocks your Q: wait until he's used it.
matchup_notes.Syndra: Dive when her stun is on cooldown.
matchup_notes.Vex: Her passive stops your dashes: don't engage when it's charged.

Qiyana|mid.mid_game: Roams with the grass element, picks and fights near walls and the river.
Qiyana|mid.late_game: Look for an ultimate into a wall on several enemies, then burst the carry.
Qiyana|mid.ahead: Roam, create picks and take objectives.
Qiyana|mid.behind: Look for picks on isolated targets and a decisive ultimate.
Qiyana|mid.win_condition: To win this game, you want to dominate your lane, roam and create fights where your ultimate stuns several enemies into a wall.
Qiyana|mid.final_tip: Pick your element for the situation: water to root, grass to roam invisible, rock to finish.
